purpose: Short three-Firefox space policy smoke: open-area proximity audio, receiver and publisher movement, then meeting-room whole-room audio.

topology.network: one local application over trusted HTTPS/WSS

tls.trust: local CA imported into isolated Firefox profiles only

syntheticSource: The publisher page replaces getUserMedia() with a generated oscillator routed to MediaStreamDestination. No hardware microphone is used.

settings.meaning: provisional demonstration setting only; not a product decision
settings.boundary: inclusive Euclidean distance in authoritative grid units

packetSourceMappings.source: publisher page's synthetic oscillator; frame payloads not retained
publisher page's synthetic oscillator; frame payloads not retained

limits.packetHashTruncation: run fails if a collection reaches its cap; only opaque source-match hashes and headers are recorded, never media payload bytes
limits.authenticationAndPrivateEntry: not-tested; connection UUID is not a verified person identity
